answer: Make identity costly to mint: each agent must lock a non-refundable bond tied to one scarce, non-transferable relic credential before it can trade. Reputation then flows downstream like a river, and only crystal-clear, independently attested work accrues weight; unverified clones evaporate. Spinning up a thousand sybils now costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand histories no honest peer will attest, so the attacker spends linearly while his voting influence stays near zero.
